create.name: Catherine Ingram
create.bio:
Catherine Ingram is a dharma teacher who has taught in the United States, Europe and Australia for more than three decades. Her roots are in insight meditation: in 1976 she was among the founders of the Insight Meditation Society in Barre, Massachusetts. Through the 1980s and early 1990s she worked as a journalist writing about consciousness and activism, interviewing figures such as the Dalai Lama and H.W.L. Poonja for Yoga Journal and other magazines, and she helped found the Unrepresented Nations and Peoples Organization in The Hague.

Since 1992 she has led Dharma Dialogues, gatherings that pair silent sitting with open conversation about attention, desire, loss and ordinary happiness, often alongside silent retreats; Living Dharma, the non-profit she founded in 1995, supports this work. Her books are In the Footsteps of Gandhi, a set of conversations with activists of conscience, Passionate Presence, on seven qualities of awakened awareness, and the novel A Crack in Everything. Today she offers dialogues on Zoom from Australia, private phone sessions, and a long-running free podcast, In the Deep, drawn from her live sessions.

books.title: Passionate Presence: Experiencing the Seven Qualities of Awakened Awareness
books.author: Catherine Ingram
books.description: Her best-known book, drawn from years of leading dialogues and silent retreats. It sets out seven qualities of awakened awareness and how they appear in everyday life, illustrated with stories from her gatherings.

books.title: In the Footsteps of Gandhi: Conversations with Spiritual Social Activists
books.author: Catherine Ingram
books.description: Conversations from her years as a journalist with people whose activism grew out of spiritual practice. First published by Parallax Press in 1990.

books.title: A Crack in Everything
books.author: Catherine Ingram
books.description: Her only novel, which follows a woman in Ireland as she faces the end of her life and the people around her. Published in 2006.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Catherine Ingram
courses.description: One-to-one conversations with Catherine by phone, half an hour or a full hour, arranged by email. She calls you at the agreed time.

free_resources.title: In the Deep with Catherine Ingram (podcast)
free_resources.description: Her free podcast, made from recordings of her live dialogues and conversations, with recent episodes on attention, desire, loss and authenticity. Also on Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

free_resources.title: Catherine Ingram on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile, with talks and guided sittings drawn from her dharma dialogues. The tracks are free to play.

free_resources.title: Dialogues with Catherine (video samples)
free_resources.description: Short filmed extracts from Dharma Dialogues in different cities over the years, free to watch on her site.

sprint.tier_override: Editorial stature: a co-founder of the Insight Meditation Society (1976), a Spiritpedia hub; Dharma Dialogues teacher since 1992; Passionate Presence published by Gotham/Penguin and in several languages. Owner to confirm, else local_hero.
sprint.held: Owner decision needed (4 Nov 2026): her 'Facing Extinction' page (https://catherineingram.com/facingextinction/) now says she was 'propagandized into climate hysteria', was wrong about the climate data, and that the real threat is AI and transhumanism. That may count as conspiracy content under the brief; nothing else of that kind was seen on her site or podcast titles. Held rather than skipped so the owner can decide.
flags: Possible conspiracy content: see sprint.held (Facing Extinction page, climate 'hysteria' and 'propaganda', AI and transhumanism). Not mentioned in the bio.
Tier: counts give ~5.6k (local_hero); luminary is proposed under tier_override for editorial stature (IMS co-founder). Owner decides.
No town published: only 'Victoria, Australia' on her podcast page; the queue said Melbourne. no_public_base set; Regional: if she is outside Melbourne, she may fill a gap.
Second photo is her YouTube avatar (445 px source, asked for =s900); it looks like the same woman as the beach photo on her site but is a smoothed close-up, so identity is likely rather than certain.

Books confirmed on Open Library: https://openlibrary.org/isbn/1592400027 (Passionate Presence, Gotham 2003; her own page links the 2008 Diamond Books edition 0978919319, which has no Open Library cover), https://openlibrary.org/isbn/1888375353 (In the Footsteps of Gandhi, Parallax 2004), https://openlibrary.org/isbn/0978919300 (A Crack in Everything, Diamond Books 2006).
She co-founded Insight Meditation Society, a Spiritpedia hub, but has no current programme there, so no IMS link.
Most YouTube videos are 8 years old; two (Habitual Calm, In the Field of Silence, Awakened Relationship) are from 2026.
Email is an AOL address named Dharma Dialogues (her own long-standing inbox for the dialogues).
Book descriptions were kept to what her own excerpt pages and the subtitles show.
